name: UA741 Inverting Amplifier (textbook canon, gain = -Rf/R_in, with R_p bias compensation)
description: UA741 in inverting configuration following the textbook canon (e.g. Sedra/Smith ch.2): R_in from VIN to pin 2 (inverting input); R_f as feedback from pin 6 (output) back to pin 2; **R_p between pin 3 (non-inverting input) and GND, sized ≈ R_in ∥ R_f to compensate for input bias current** (standard practice; omitting it produces a small DC offset). Dual supply via pins 4/7. R10 fixture refresh (2026-05-18): added R_p to match the curriculum image — previously the fixture had pin 3 wired directly to GND which caused students who followed the textbook to fail with CRITICAL_EXTRA_CONNECTION.
